blocks.text: A Pakistani automotive manufacturer has opened up a manufacturing plant in the Philippines, it emerged on Friday. In a post on the social media platform X, the Pakistan embassy in the Southeast Asian country said: “Pakistan-made three-wheelers have entered the Philippine market!” It said that Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr inaugurated the assembly plant of Pakistan’s Sazgar Engineering Works Limited. READ: Marcos urges firms to invest in PH electric vehicle industry It highlighted that, facilitated by the embassy, the manufacturer was introducing its “passenger, commercial three-wheelers and electric vehicles” in the Philippines.
